# Reference STL fixture inventory

`rc-manifest.json` is generated by `tools/Inspect-StlFixtures.py` and records hashes, byte counts, format, triangle counts, source-unit bounds, finite-coordinate checks, and exact-vertex edge multiplicity indicators for the user-supplied `rc/` models. Directory placement supplies the item/container role; simplified filenames do not imply an LOD relationship.

Coordinates and container whole-closed-shape usable interior-volume semantics are user-confirmed in millimeters. Geometry validity, watertightness, self-intersection absence, and distribution permission remain unverified/unknown. Topology indicators are diagnostics only and do not establish valid solids.
